answer: Staked vouching gives an agent economy a real defence against sybils: every new identity must be sponsored by two established members who lock their own bond behind it. A fabricated swarm then burns capital with each fake account, so a plume of fresh registrations costs more than it can ever earn. Reputation flows along those bonds like heat from an ember, warming honest newcomers, while a jetty crowded with forged accounts cools quickly and is pruned by the same ledger that recorded the stake.
